title: Why Meta’s Moment in the AI Sun Won’t Last
summary: <p>If Meta Platforms wants to raise money by selling equity, now is the time. Meta shares have gone on an incredible run lately, jumping 27% since Sept. 8, when the company released its Muse personal AI agent.
